# Security Checklist: Authentication and Role Management

**Purpose**: Review the clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability of security and API requirements for this feature
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all public registration fields, their required/optional status, and their validation boundaries defined? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-001–FR-002; Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are normalized username and email uniqueness rules defined consistently for existing records and new accounts? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-003; Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are every user-management route and its required role covered, including legacy CRUD, search, stored-procedure lookup, and SQL-user listing? [Coverage, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-012–FR-014; Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK004 Are safe provisioning requirements for legacy user records and first-Admin establishment complete, including who may invoke each flow? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-011, FR-021, FR-023]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for preserving user profile data and handling migration preflight conflicts without deleting or merging records? [Coverage, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-021; Plan §Constitution Check]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are username/email normalization operations (including whitespace handling, case rules, and accepted length) explicit and identical across registration, login, and provisioning? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-003; Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Are password length and other input limits sufficiently bounded to make validation and safe processing unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-002, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “five consecutive failed attempts” unambiguously defined for unknown, disabled, already-locked, and post-expiry accounts, including when the failure counter resets? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-024]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the required JWT issuer, audience, lifetime, signing-key source, and claim semantics stated in the normative requirements rather than only in design artifacts? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-007–FR-009; Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the externally observable response status and error-body rules sufficiently precise for invalid credentials, locked accounts, invalid tokens, and insufficient roles? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-006–FR-007, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Are bootstrap secret delivery, one-time use, invalid-secret responses, and post-success removal/rotation requirements explicit enough for safe operation? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-008, FR-023; API Contract §Authentication]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the requirements consistently state when role changes and account disablement affect existing access tokens and protected requests? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-015; API Contract §JWT behavior]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the requirements define whether role/status changes revoke already-open WebSocket connections, or clearly accept authorization lasting until disconnect? [Conflict, Spec §User Story 2; API Contract §JWT behavior]
- [ ] CHK014 Are public registration, legacy-account provisioning, and initial bootstrap consistently prevented from creating unauthorized Admin access? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-011, FR-014, FR-023; API Contract §Authentication]
- [ ] CHK015 Are account-based lockout requirements consistent with the generic login response and the requirement not to reveal whether an account exists? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-017, FR-024]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can the requirement to prevent exposing credentials be objectively evaluated across API responses, all credential-bearing logs, and password persistence? [Measurability, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-004–FR-005, FR-017; Spec §Success Criteria SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Do success criteria explicitly cover case-variant duplicates, concurrent registrations/bootstrap attempts, lockout expiry/reset, and last-Admin protection? [Coverage, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001–SC-008]
- [ ] CHK018 Are acceptable performance or availability targets for registration, login, token validation, and user listing defined, or explicitly deferred as unnecessary for this release? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria; Plan §Technical Context]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are alternate and failure scenarios for registration, login, bootstrap, role changes, and legacy provisioning fully specified, including concurrent state changes? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing; Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery expectations defined when migration preflight fails, bootstrap rolls back, or a role/status change conflicts with the last-Admin rule? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-016, FR-021, FR-023]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements explicit for roles that are unsupported, duplicated, removed from an enabled account, or assigned to a disabled account? [Coverage, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-010–FR-016; Data Model §UserRole]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Are deployment responsibilities for database backup, secret provisioning, bootstrap-secret rotation, and migration approval assigned or explicitly documented as operational assumptions? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Technical Context; Quickstart §Safe database rollout]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the API collection requirement specify safe test-only configuration and avoid requiring real credentials or production data? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4; Spec §Functional Requirements FR-019; API Contract §API request collection]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- This checklist evaluates requirement quality, not whether code or tests have been implemented.
